platforms.name: Google Ads
platforms.note: The account delivered 45,802 impressions and 1,353 clicks on $247.07 across both campaigns that spent, for a $0.18 blended CPC. The Leads Performance Max row showed 43.99 attributed Google conversion events: 11.99 Web Contact Form and 31.99 Web Phone Calls. This report counts them as 44 whole-number Google leads. No Get Directions Click action row was recorded.
